messages:
Priya: FYI legal flagged several docs/examples that embed what look like real PII. We also have the v1->v2 deprecation + model alias swap next month. Need a coordinated docs run: de-identify examples, add deprecation banners, and publish a migration guide.
Evan: Can we script the sanitization? I can do a repo-wide replace for emails/names and add a short banner include for deprecated endpoints.
Sam: We'll also need explicit SDK snippets for both sides (v1 and v2) and a short compatibility table in the migration guide. I'll own JS/Python snippets + changelog entry.
Tina: Note: some READMEs in samples/ are used by interviews — those must be highest priority. Also, `open-quant-7b` -> `redwood-q-7b` alias swap will break a handful of sample configs.
Anu: I'll run the docs smoke CI after changes; last time a snippet broke because of param rename in embeddings.
legal-bot: Please replace any literal email addresses, phone numbers, or company identifiers with clearly synthetic tokens. Recommended tokens: <NAME>, <EMAIL>, <ORG>. Add a short footer: "Examples sanitized for privacy."
Evan: Plan proposal: 1) run grep for email-like patterns and keys, 2) apply scripted replacements to `.md` and `.rst`, 3) open multiple small PRs with preview builds, 4) add migration include file for deprecation banner.
Priya: Sounds good. Also add redirect rules for retired v1 pages to avoid 404s. We'll keep v1 archived but reachable with a banner saying "deprecated, see v2 migration guide."
Sam: Sample snippet examples (for docs):
```bash
# v1 curl
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"hi"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_KEY>'

# v2 curl
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/responses -d '{"model":"redwood-v2","input":"hi"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_KEY>'
```
Sam: Also embedding param rename: v1 used `dimension`, v2 uses `vector_dim`. Will show side-by-side.
Tina: I'll update sample-app branches: `samples/update-model-alias-1850` and `samples/remove-v1-banner-1850`. I'll also update model tables in the quickstart.
Evan: I'll create a small Node script to run replacements and output a report of changed files. Branch: `docs/clean-pii-1850`.
Anu: ci-bot: docs-snippet-smoke-test failed on `samples/chat-demo` due to new `responses.create` name — we need to update the runner to accept both APIs or standardize snippets first.
Priya: Good catch. For the doc runner, prioritize supporting both names for the next two weeks or else the CI will block many PRs. Evan, can you add a transient compatibility shim?
Evan: Yes I can add a small adapter in the doc runner to map old v1 calls to v2 for smoke tests: `shim/v1-to-v2-adapter.js`. I'll include tests.
Sam: Changelog blurb (draft): "Deprecate v1 API. Users should migrate to responses.create and embeddings create with vector_dim. See migration guide for code samples and automated scripts." Short and actionable.
Priya: Assignments: Evan (replace script + doc-runner shim), Sam (snippets + changelog), Tina (samples + model alias table), Anu (smoke CI / final QA), Priya (migration guide + redirects + legal coordination). Everyone drop PR links here.
Tina: Timeline idea: start PRs tomorrow, small batches during the week, finish merges by end-of-week. Add docs banner on staging Friday.
legal-bot: Will prioritize review of the sanitize PRs. Tagging: @legal-team.
ci-bot: placeholder-pr: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9999
Priya: Thanks — please paste PR URLs here as you open them and update the migration guide checklist in the draft. :sparkles:
